description: This file defines a JSP custom tag class ProductDescriptionUrlTag that constructs and outputs a product URL based on product details, store configuration, and request context in an e-commerce application.

classes.name: ProductDescriptionUrlTag
classes.description: A custom JSP tag class to generate product URLs for storefront display based on product and store data.

methods.name: doStartTag
methods.description: Main method that builds and outputs the product URL based on the current request, session, and product details.

methods.name: doEndTag
methods.description: Handles the end of tag processing, simply continues page evaluation.
